title: 第1章 跟班二号第2章 进入游戏
content_zh:
网游之全职跟班
公元2288年，人类历史揭开全新篇章，一款名为《封神》的全息虚拟网游横空出世，在联邦政府的大力支持下，这款网游走进了无数财团的视线。
…………
华夏国华北地区，一座豪华的家族别墅中，这里是一件阴冷的库房，刘烨仔细打量着手中的戒指，神色恍惚无比，身为《封神》顶尖玩家的他自然知道这是什么东西，这个戒指就是《封神》的登录器。
揉揉眼睛，认真看着手腕上的老旧质子手表，刘烨更加的茫然起来：“公元2288年6月30号？！”
记忆里，自己活在2291年，正是《封神》无限繁荣的时候，自己作为联邦第一位达到90级的玩家，同样是在6月30号，《封神》的三周年庆典上，自己的明星级ID剑红尘在万众瞩目下开启天劫，当那漫天雷霆奔涌而来的时候，自己霎那间失去了意识。
睁开眼睛的时候，自己已经躺在这间杂乱的库房里面，属于另一个人的记忆杂乱的穿cha在自己的脑海中！
确定现在的时间以后，刘烨知道，自己穿越了，而且不偏不倚的回到了三年前游戏开服的那一天。
更加悲惨的是，自己现在的身份只是一个打杂的，准确点说，自己只是叶家二小姐刚刚找来的跟班，而且已经跟人家签订了三年的卖身合同！
“还有什么比这个更悲催的吗？”刘烨无力的呐喊着，自己堂堂的明星级玩家，竟然沦落到给人当跟班的地步。
好在今晚8点《封神》就要准时开服了，自己热爱的游戏没有离开自己！
说起自己现在的女主人叶雨蝶，那可是华北区叶家二小姐，整个华北区无人不知无人不晓，你可以称她为恶魔，但是嘴上必须叫她天使，你可以骂他欺男霸女，但是嘴上必须说成乐于助人。
在这具身体原主人的记忆里，叶家二小姐是叶家的毒瘤，华北区的恶霸，华夏国的败类，整个联邦的异类！
自己一个为工作奔走的大好青年就是因为恶霸二小姐的欺压才沦为她的跟班，更可悲的是，自己的三年的卖身佣金只有可怜的36联邦币。
“简直欺人太甚！”想到这里，刘烨就忍不住想要冲出去找恶霸二小姐理论一番。
可是自己跟人家有明确的卖身合同，受到联邦法律的保护，三年之内自己就是恶霸二小姐的法定跟班，一个任人宰割的可怜人！
刘烨深深的扫视四周，这间杂乱的仓库就是自己今后生活的地方，弥漫着阵阵潮湿的腐臭味。
“爸爸，妈妈！你们还好吗？”
恍惚之间，刘烨开始想念自己的父母，三年前的今天，自己应该还在兴奋的玩弄登录器戒指吧？
想到这里，刘烨不自觉握紧了拳头，没有什么比有家不能回更加痛苦的事情了！

刘烨急切的想要弄明白，三年后究竟是什么原因让自己穿越时间，回到三年前的今天？联邦的服务器究竟出现了怎样的故障？
就在这个时候，库房外传来一阵急促的脚步声，紧接着，一道蛮横的嗓音响起：“二号，快给本小姐出来，不然打断你的狗腿！”
刘烨心中一颤，急忙走出库房，一抹娇小可爱的身影出现在眼前，翠绿色的精致衣裙，白皙的肌肤，精致的五官，俏脸上挂满人畜无害的微笑。
没错，眼前这位超极品小萝莉就是华北区赫赫有名的恶霸二小姐——叶雨蝶！
这样一个可爱的小萝莉站在面前，刘烨却生不出丝毫想要怜惜的感觉，在刘烨看来，恶霸二小姐有着天使般的身材和气质，同时也具备着恶魔般的思维和心xing。
完全就是一朵带刺的玫瑰花苞，千万不要被她的外表所迷惑，那样，你的下场会很惨，很惨，很很惨！
站在恶霸二小姐身后的还有一名青年，名叫王光，是二小姐的跟班一号，和自己年纪相仿，和自己有着相同的遭遇，唯一不同的就是，王光似乎很满意现在的生活，整天跟着二小姐欺男霸女，深得二小姐赞许。
“二……小姐！”刘烨生涩的张了张嘴，好不容易才叫出这个称呼。
恶霸二小姐满意的点点头，伸出可爱白嫩的小手指了指两人，说道：“一号，二号，你们以后跟着本小姐混，要好好听话！”
“身为小姐的忠实跟班，王光愿意为小姐赴汤蹈火在所不辞！”王光恭敬的巴结道。
刘烨不由撇嘴，鄙夷的看着王光，什么忠实跟班，顶多算是一只忠实的走狗！
“你呢……？”二小姐得意的点头，然后将目光转向刘烨这边，无暇的俏脸上浮现两道浅浅的酒窝。
“小子当然也是一样，赴汤蹈火，在所不辞！”刘烨赶忙回答，心中早已冷汗阵阵，如果真惹毛了恶霸二小姐，等待自己的将是无限痛苦的人生。
听到两个小弟的回答，二小姐叶雨蝶相当的满意，叉着小蛮腰点点头，说道：“不错，二号刚来，以后要向一号学习，跟着本小姐好好混，一定不会亏待你们的！”
“多谢小姐栽培！”一旁的王光急忙拍着马屁，刘烨无奈的跟着王光拍拍马屁，自己都觉得自己恶心。
“好了，跟我走吧！《封神》就要开服了，母亲和姐姐都在等我呢！听说游戏里怎么欺负人都不算犯法，我要让整个联邦的人都知道我叶家二小姐的厉害，你们两个就是我的头号打手，一定要给我好好努力！”二小姐一本正经的教导着。
两人赶忙赔笑点头。
抬起头的时候，刘烨不自觉的摸了一把汗，只见恶霸二小姐已经蹦跳着向前走去，两名跟班急忙快步跟上去。
“二号，以后你听我的就可以了，等我哪天把两位小姐搞定的时候，绝对不会忘记你的！”跟班一号王光自信满满的笑道。
刘烨不由来了兴趣，诧异的问道：“哦？王哥还有这种手段？”

“那是，想当年哥可是纵横花海的无敌英雄！给我一点时间，我必然可以将两位如花似玉的小姐拿下，到时候这整个叶家还不是我王光一个人说了算？”
刘烨哑然，心中暗笑不已，装作一副吃惊的样子，巴结道：“没想到王哥这么厉害，等你以后飞黄腾达的时候，千万不要忘了小弟我啊！”
刘烨这一声马屁让王光舒服透了，满意的拍拍刘烨的肩膀，说道：“是金子在哪里都会发光，这不是《封神》就要开服了吗？哥可是游戏高手，不出一个月，哥在叶家的地位必然会像坐火箭一样冲天而起，只要哥有肉吃，至少也会给你口汤尝尝！”
“那是那是，王哥一定可以成功！”刘烨不温不火的拍着马屁，心中却是冷笑不跌，在哥面前自称游戏高手？哥当年可是全联邦第一个升到90级的玩家，跟哥投怀送抱的女粉丝不知道有多少？
对于王光，刘烨只把他当成一个自我感觉太过良好的无知小盆友！
紧紧跟随恶霸二小姐的脚步，三人很快来到一座高楼别墅脚下，脚踩磁悬浮电梯，很快便来到了叶家的会议室。
宽敞的叶家会议室，阳光透过落地窗将整个房间照亮，充满了干净与整洁的气息，一圈环形会议桌摆在房间中央，一位冷艳的少妇坐在主席位置，凹凸有致的身材让人喷血不已，此人便是华北区有名的女强人，叶家夫人月玲珑！
叶夫人左边，端坐着一位青春貌美的女子，看上去和恶霸二小姐有些相像，不过要比二小姐成熟许多，此女便是叶家大小姐叶雨轩了！
再然后就是一些叶家的管事和高价聘请过来的游戏职业高手，看着阵势，叶家似乎想要在《封神》里大干一场。
唯一令刘烨怪异的就是，大小姐叶雨轩的旁边坐着两位青年，看上去跟自己身份差不多，应该也是跟班一类的！
“雨蝶，快过来坐！”看到二小姐进来，叶夫人黛眉紧蹙，责怪的叫道，直接将她身后的刘烨二人当成了空气。
“来了来了！”二小姐娇笑一声，领着刘烨两个人坐在叶夫人的右边空位上，而刘烨和王光两个跟班只能恭敬的站在二小姐的背后，根本没有人注意到他们。
到此时，刘烨才恍然明白，原来大小姐身边那两位并不是跟班，人家是大小姐拉来为叶家集团效力的游戏高手，不是自己这样的跟班能够媲美的！
扭头看向王光，他丫的刚刚还一副臭屁轰轰的样子，现在怂的就跟一坨屎似得，大气也不敢出。
扫视四周，在座的大大们全都把他当成了空气，这让刘烨心中万分的不爽，习惯了当年的万众瞩目，这样的无视让他很不爽！
此时，二小姐就坐之后，叶夫人终于发话了，“大家都是我叶家聘请来的游戏高手，目的已经向大家说明白了，《封神》这款游戏前景巨大，我们叶家一定要在前一个月抢占先机，在游戏中建立最强公会，众位放开胆子发挥，资金由我们叶家承担！”
此言一出，下方人员纷纷表示赞同，大小姐身边的两位游戏高手纷纷表示效忠！
“好大，真的好大！”刘烨根本没有关心会议的内容，整个人的心思全都放在了近在咫尺的叶夫人身上。
从刘烨这个位置，刚好可以透过衣襟，看到那波涛汹涌的深邃ru-沟，直叫人喷血不已！刘烨险些流出口水！
正在欣赏的刘烨心中猛地一颤，只感觉一道凌烈的杀气从左边传来，急忙摆正脸色，偷偷看去，只见大小姐叶雨轩银牙紧咬的盯着自己，仿佛要把自己吃了一样。

刘烨被吓得一阵哆嗦，慌张的学习王光低下头，认真的聆听叶夫人演讲！
content_en:
Full-time follower in online games
In 2288 AD, human history opened a new chapter. A holographic virtual online game called "Fengshen" was born. With the strong support of the federal government, this online game entered the attention of countless financial groups.
…………
In the northern region of China, in a luxurious family villa, there was a cold warehouse. Liu Ye carefully looked at the ring in his hand, with a dazed look on his face. As a top player of "Fengshen", he naturally knew what it was. This ring was the login device of "Fengshen".
Rubbing his eyes and looking seriously at the old proton watch on his wrist, Liu Ye became even more confused: "June 30, 2288 AD?!"
In my memory, I lived in 2291, when "Feng Shen" was infinitely prosperous. As the first player in the Federation to reach level 90, on June 30, at the third anniversary celebration of "Feng Shen", my star-level ID Jian Hongchen started a catastrophe in front of everyone. When the thunder rushed from the sky, I lost consciousness in an instant.
When he opened his eyes, he was already lying in this messy warehouse, and memories belonging to another person were wandering through his mind!
After confirming the current time, Liu Ye knew that he had traveled through time and returned to the day when the game was launched three years ago.
What is even more tragic is that my current identity is just a handyman. To be more precise, I am just a follower that the second lady of the Ye family has just hired, and I have already signed a three-year prostitution contract with her!
"Is there anything more tragic than this?" Liu Ye shouted feebly. He was a star player, but he was reduced to being a follower.
Fortunately, the server of "Fengshen" will be launched on time at 8 o'clock tonight, and the game I love has not left me!
Speaking of his current mistress, Ye Yudie, she is the second young lady of the Ye family in North China District. Everyone in North China District knows her. You can call her a devil, but you must call her an angel. You can call her a bully, but you must say she is helpful.
In the memory of the original owner of this body, the second young lady of the Ye family is the cancer of the Ye family, the bully of North China, the scum of China, and the alien of the entire federation!
I am a good young man who works hard only to become her follower because of the bullying of the bully second lady. What is even more tragic is that my commission for selling my body for three years is only a pitiful 36 federal coins.
"This is too much!" Thinking of this, Liu Ye couldn't help but want to rush out and argue with the bully second lady.
However, he had a clear contract of prostitution with her, and was protected by federal law. Within three years, he would be the legal follower of the bully second lady, a pitiful person at the mercy of others!
Liu Ye glanced deeply around. This messy warehouse was where he would live in the future. It was filled with damp and rotten smells.
"Dad, Mom! Are you okay?"
In a daze, Liu Ye began to miss his parents. Three years ago today, he should still be excitedly playing with the login ring, right?
Thinking of this, Liu Ye clenched his fists unconsciously. There is nothing more painful than having a home and not being able to return!
Liu Ye was eager to find out what caused him to travel through time three years later and return to today three years ago? What kind of failure occurred in the federation's server?
At this time, there was a rush of footsteps outside the warehouse, and then a arrogant voice sounded: "No. 2, come out quickly, or I will break your dog legs!"
Liu Ye's heart trembled, and he hurriedly walked out of the warehouse. A petite and cute figure appeared in front of him, wearing an exquisite emerald green dress, fair skin, exquisite facial features, and a pretty face full of harmless smiles.
That's right, this super-superb little lolita in front of you is the famous bully Erxiao from North China District.Sister - Ye Yudie!
With such a cute little loli standing in front of her, Liu Ye couldn't feel the slightest pity. In Liu Ye's view, the second bully lady had an angelic figure and temperament, but also had a devilish mind and mentality.
She is just like a rose bud with thorns. Don’t be fooled by her appearance. Otherwise, your end will be very miserable, very miserable, very miserable!
Standing behind the bully second lady is a young man named Wang Guang, who is the number one follower of the second lady. He is similar in age to himself and has the same experience as himself. The only difference is that Wang Guang seems to be very satisfied with his current life. He follows the second lady to bully men and women all day long, and is highly praised by the second lady.
"Second...Miss!" Liu Ye opened his mouth awkwardly and finally managed to say this title.
Miss Bully No. 2 nodded with satisfaction, pointed at the two of them with her cute white little finger, and said, "No. 1, No. 2, you will follow me from now on, so be obedient!"
"As Miss's loyal follower, Wang Guang is willing to go through fire and water for Miss!" Wang Guang said respectfully.
Liu Ye couldn't help but curl his lips and looked at Wang Guang with disdain. What kind of loyal follower is at best a loyal lackey?
"What about you...?" The second lady nodded proudly, then turned her gaze to Liu Ye, with two shallow dimples appearing on her flawless and pretty face.
"Of course the same goes for the boy. He will go through fire and water without hesitation!" Liu Ye replied quickly, sweating in his heart. If he really offended the bully second lady, he would be waiting for a life of infinite pain.
Hearing the answers from the two younger brothers, the second young lady Ye Yudie was quite satisfied. She put her hands on her waist and nodded, saying, "That's right. Number 2 has just arrived. I will learn from Number 1 in the future. Follow me and have a good time. I will definitely not treat you badly!"
"Thank you, Miss, for your cultivation!" Wang Guang on the side quickly flattered him, and Liu Ye helplessly followed Wang Guang's flattery, even feeling disgusted himself.
"Okay, come with me! The server of "Feng Shen" is about to start, and my mother and sister are waiting for me! I heard that it is not illegal to bully people in the game. I want everyone in the entire federation to know how powerful I, the second young lady of the Ye family, are. You two are my number one thugs. You must work hard for me!" the second young lady taught seriously.
The two of them quickly smiled and nodded.
When he raised his head, Liu Ye sweated unconsciously and saw that the bully second lady had jumped forward, and the two followers hurriedly followed her.
"No. 2, just listen to me from now on. When I take care of these two ladies one day, I will never forget you!" Follower No. 1 Wang Guang said with a confident smile.
Liu Ye couldn't help but become interested and asked in surprise: "Oh? Brother Wang still has such a method?"
"That's right, back then I was an invincible hero across the sea of flowers! Give me some time, and I will definitely be able to capture these two beautiful young ladies. By then, won't I, Wang Guang, have the final say over the entire Ye family?"
Liu Ye was speechless, laughing secretly in his heart, pretending to be surprised, and said flatteringly: "I didn't expect Brother Wang to be so powerful. When you become famous in the future, don't forget me!"
Liu Ye's flattery made Wang Guang feel comfortable. He patted Liu Ye's shoulder with satisfaction and said, "Gold will shine wherever it is. Isn't this the launch of the "Fengshen" server? I am a master of the game. In less than a month, my status in the Ye family will definitely skyrocket like a rocket. As long as I have meat to eat, I will at least give you a taste of soup!"
"That's that, Brother Wang will definitely succeed!" Liu Ye flattered him tepidly, but he sneered in his heart, calling himself a game master in front of his brother? At that time, I was the first player in the federation to reach level 90. How many female fans embraced me?
For Wang Guang, Liu Ye only regarded him as himselfIgnorant little friend who feels too good!
Following closely in the footsteps of the second bully lady, the three of them quickly arrived at the foot of a high-rise villa. They stepped on the maglev elevator and soon arrived at the Ye family's conference room.
In the spacious Ye family conference room, sunlight shines through the floor-to-ceiling windows, filling the room with a clean and tidy atmosphere. A circular conference table is placed in the center of the room. A cold and charming young woman sits in the chairperson's position. Her curvy figure makes people bleed. This person is the famous strong woman in North China, Mrs. Yue Linglong of the Ye family!
To the left of Mrs. Ye, sits a young and beautiful woman, who looks somewhat similar to the bully second lady, but is much more mature than the second lady. This girl is Ye Yuxuan, the eldest lady of the Ye family!
Then there are some stewards of the Ye family and professional gaming experts hired at high prices. Looking at the formation, it seems that the Ye family wants to have a big fight in "Fengshen".
The only thing that makes Liu Ye weird is that there are two young men sitting next to the eldest lady Ye Yuxuan. They seem to have similar identities to himself, and they should be like followers!
"Yudie, come and sit down!" Seeing the second young lady coming in, Mrs. Ye frowned and shouted accusingly, dismissing Liu Ye and Liu Ye behind her as nothing.
"Come on, come on!" The second young lady gave a sweet smile and led Liu Ye and two people to sit in the empty seat on the right side of Mrs. Ye. The two followers, Liu Ye and Wang Guang, could only stand respectfully behind the second young lady, and no one noticed them at all.
Only then did Liu Ye suddenly understand that the two people around the eldest lady were not followers. They were game masters recruited by the eldest lady to work for the Ye Family Group. They were not comparable to followers like himself!
Turning to look at Wang Guang, he looked like a stinking fart just now, but now he was as cowardly as a piece of shit and didn't dare to express his anger.
Looking around, everyone here regarded him as nothing, which made Liu Ye feel extremely unhappy. He was used to being the center of attention back then, so such disregard made him very unhappy!
At this time, after the second young lady sat down, Mrs. Ye finally spoke, "You are all game masters hired by my Ye family. The purpose has been made clear to everyone. The game "Feng Shen" has great prospects. Our Ye family must seize the opportunity in the first month and establish the strongest guild in the game. Everyone, please feel free to show your courage. The funds will be borne by our Ye family!"
As soon as this statement came out, the people below expressed their agreement, and the two game masters around the eldest lady expressed their allegiance!
"It's so big, it's really so big!" Liu Ye didn't care about the content of the meeting at all. His whole mind was focused on Mrs. Ye, who was very close at hand.
From Liu Ye's position, he could just see the deep and turbulent ditch through his clothes, which made people bleed! Liu Ye almost drooled!
Liu Ye, who was admiring it, suddenly trembled in his heart. He felt a fierce murderous aura coming from the left. He hurriedly straightened his face and looked secretly. He saw the eldest lady Ye Yuxuan staring at him with her silver teeth clenched, as if she wanted to eat him.
Liu Ye was so frightened that he trembled and hurriedly studied. Wang Guang lowered his head and listened carefully to Mrs. Ye's speech!
